signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.failed: That email and password do not match an account.
signIn.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
signIn.locked: This account is paused for fifteen minutes.

triage.title: Today
triage.heading: Who needs you today
triage.summaryNone: Nobody is waiting on you right now
triage.emptyBody: When a student asks to be heard, falls behind, or a guardian asks to be linked, they appear here.
triage.notYetRecorded: This class has no recorded evidence yet
triage.notYetRecordedBody: Triage ranks what has been recorded. Nothing has been recorded for this class, so there is nothing to rank.

reason.guardian_claim_waiting: A guardian is waiting to be linked · {hoursWaiting}h
reason.repeated_lapses: {lapses} passages slipped in the last two weeks
reason.reviews_overdue: Past due: {overdue} of {tracked} recorded units · oldest {daysOverdue}d
reason.recommendation_unacted: A suggested next step has stood for {days} days
reason.recommendation_acted: Acted on the suggested next step

verify.title: Verify
verify.heading: Waiting to be heard
verify.empty: Nobody is waiting to be heard
verify.emptyBody: A student asks to be heard when they believe a passage is ready.
verify.markHelp: Tap a word on the page, then choose what happened there. A correction records a position — never text.
verify.chooseWordFirst: Choose a word on the page first
verify.wentToHelp: For a wrong join: which āyah did they go to instead?
verify.onceOnly: A verdict is your word, recorded once.
verify.onceOnlyBody: It cannot be edited. If you change your mind, the student asks again and you record a new one — so what you actually said survives.
verify.alreadyDecided: This one already has a verdict. Nothing was changed.
verify.notAllowed: You are not the teacher for this student.
verify.failed: That did not record. Nothing was written.
verify.pageMissing: The page for this passage is not in the content package

assign.title: Assign
assign.heading: New assignment
assign.failed: That did not save. Nothing was assigned.
assign.whoEmpty: This class has nobody enrolled yet
assign.whatHelp: References only — sūrah and āyah numbers, page numbers, lesson ids. The Qurʾān itself is never copied into an assignment; the student's device reads it from the muṣḥaf.
assign.howHelp: These settings are locked for the student. They cannot change them.
assign.reviewHeading: What each student will see tomorrow
assign.reviewEar: and will recite it to you before it counts
assign.reviewNoEar: and it counts without being heard

problem.range_out_of_bounds: That reference is outside the muṣḥaf
problem.arabic_text_in_payload: An assignment carries references only, never text
problem.too_many_units: That is more than anyone can hold. Narrow the range.

students.title: Students
students.heading: The class
students.emptyBody: Share the class code and students will appear here.
students.memoryInk: Ink depth shows what has been earned. A blank word is not a failure — it is a word not yet reached.
students.notEnough: Not yet recorded — {needed} more needed before a rate means anything

presence.heading: In class now
presence.lost: The live view stopped. Reload to watch again.
presence.notTelemetry: This shows who is working now. Nothing is stored.

khatma.title: Khatma
khatma.heading: Listening to a long recitation
khatma.acrossSessions: Flags stay until you resolve them, across every session.

readingGate.title: Reading gate
readingGate.heading: Confirm a rung in person
readingGate.lede: The Qāʿidah rungs are confirmed face to face. Recording it here says exactly that, and a report can never present it as anything else.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.failedDelivery: Could not be sent — tell them yourself

kind.verification_requested: A student asked to be heard
kind.guardian_claim: A guardian asked to be linked

notifications.refused: Not sent on this channel — they have not agreed to it
